001: I want to return this shirt, but I can't find the receipt.
Don't worry, I can look it up with the order number.
Is it okay if I give you the confirmation email?
Yes, that's enough. What's the reason for the return?
It's too small for me, and I'd prefer to change the size.
Understood. I'll exchange it for a bigger size, no problem.
002: This jacket has a loose seam on the sleeve.
I'm very sorry, we hadn't detected that defect.
Could you fix it for me or give me another one?
We can exchange it for you right now if we have your size.
And what if you don't have it in stock?
Then we would give you a full refund on the spot.
003: I wanted to confirm if the shipment of my shoes has already gone out.
Let me check the system with your tracking number.
They told me it would arrive between today and tomorrow.
That's right, it's scheduled to arrive tomorrow afternoon.
Do I need to be home to receive it?
No need, the delivery driver can leave it at the entrance.
004: This lamp doesn't work, even though I just bought it.
Wow, that's strange. Have you tried it with another light bulb?
Yes, and it still doesn't turn on. I think it came defective.
I'm going to ask the manufacturer to send me a new one.
How long will it take for the replacement to arrive?
I estimate you'll have it in about five business days.
005: I'd like to know if this store matches online prices.
Yes, if you show us the price on another website, we'll match it.
I found the same phone twenty euros cheaper.
Perfect, then we'll give it to you at the same price.
And do you also apply the official warranty?
Of course, the warranty is the same as if you bought it here.
006: The bag I bought has a stain that won't come out.
Will you bring it in so we can assess the condition of the item?
Yes, I have it here with the original bag.
Let me take a look at it for a moment, please.
Do you think they can exchange it for me?
Since it has a factory defect, we'll exchange it for you, no problem.
007: I want to cancel my order because I'm no longer interested.
I understand, but the package is already out for delivery.
So it can't be canceled anymore?
Unfortunately not, but you can refuse it at the delivery.
And do you refund the money automatically?
Yes, as soon as the package returns to our warehouse.
008: Could you give me an invoice with the tax breakdown?
Of course, I'll generate it right now from the system.
I need it to justify the expense at my company.
I'll send it to you by email in a few minutes.
Can it also include the tax identification number?
Yes, tell it to me and I'll update it with that information.
009: I bought two chairs and only one has arrived.
I apologize for the error, I'm going to check the delivery note.
Only one box came in the package.
You're right, the warehouse split the order into two shipments.
When will they bring me the second chair?
They'll deliver it to you tomorrow morning at no extra cost.
010: This blender makes a very strange noise when you use it.
Since when have you noticed that noise when it runs?
Since the first day, but I thought it was normal.
No, it shouldn't sound like that. We'll exchange it for a new one.
Could you give me one of a different model?
Yes, you can choose another model and you only pay the difference.
